ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Execution via Rsync - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the "rsync" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\/rsync$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/rsyncd$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/dash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/csh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/sh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/zsh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/tcsh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ksh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'ash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'bash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'dash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'csh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'sh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'zsh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'tcsh\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\'ksh\\ .*")))
